points.why: All six CATWOE elements are given with specific content for each.
The worldview that a lecture is mainly one-way content transfer is stated explicitly and set against competing worldviews.
It flags the contested T, hidden costs in other budgets and overlooked at-risk first-years, and says these shift the goal from cost to retained learners and widen what the business case must include.

notes: Listing unions, student unions and regulators under Owner stretches the term, since these are parties with veto power rather than the system owner, but it is a minor point.
